summary: Retire the unused filesystem Sent ledger and its catalog send entrypoint

replay.detail: Current claims-graph message publication, idempotency and native delivery receipts are unchanged.

schema.detail: No on-disk cleanup or wire schema change. Existing Sent files remain untouched; current inbox and archive formats remain supported.

rules.detail: No current native messaging authority or permission rule changes. Catalog declaration resolution and immutable hook-set compatibility remain.

compatibility.detail: Removes workspace-internal Sent inspection and catalog send APIs after their final old Codex reporter caller was retired. Current CLI and hook paths do not call them.

downtime.detail: No current session restart is required.

manual.detail: No cleanup is required; legacy Sent directories are not deleted.

recovery.detail: Reverting restores source APIs and can read the untouched historical Sent records.
